clues.title: It's Always the Lake
clues.text: Not a physical object — the player's own conclusion, pinned to the corkboard once enough gossip and photos point the same direction. Every disappearance this term traces back to the lake path.

clues.title: Footprints That Stop
clues.text: A single set of prints in the mud past the reed line, evenly spaced, unhurried. They stop. Nothing continues from where they stop, and nothing turns around.

clues.title: Torn School Coat
clues.text: Snagged on a dead branch above the waterline, a Thistledown uniform coat, third-year cut. The tear isn't a snag tear. It's too clean for that.
